preconditions.description: The number of skewers n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: The permutation p must have length n and contain integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(x in {0, 1} for x in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b must have length n and consist of zeros and ones.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of changes required to make the permutation and sequence suitable.
